sourceNotes.rawContent:
Make a statement with this elegant Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Bracelet Watch, featuring a rich red dial, classic Roman numeral detailing and a sleek jewellery-inspired bracelet strap. The warm gold-tone finish paired with the deep red dial creates a luxurious vintage look that instantly elevates any outfit.
Designed with an anti-tarnish finish, this watch is perfect for women who love elegant accessories with a timeless, statement-making appeal. Its unique oval-shaped dial and textured bracelet give it a distinctive vintage charm, making it more than just a timepiece—it's a stylish piece of jewellery.
Product Highlights
- ✨ Vintage-inspired bracelet watch
- 💛 Anti-tarnish gold-tone finish
- ❤️ Elegant red dial
- 🕰️ Classic Roman numeral detailing
- 🔗 Stylish textured link bracelet strap
- ⌚ Quartz movement
- 💎 Jewellery-inspired statement design
- 👗 Perfect for ethnic and western outfits
- 🎁 Ideal for gifting
- 🌸 Suitable for everyday wear, parties, dates & special occasions
Perfect For
Office wear, college looks, festive outfits, parties, casual outings, date nights and gifting.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry, dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
